title: Book Two · Chapter 179: At the Public Table
story:
The reading room has a group work time on Wednesday. Ronan arrives ten minutes before it ends. He stops outside when he sees Leo and Mei at the small desk.

Miss Wu is checking a packet with them. Several sheets are spread across the table. Ronan cannot read the words from the doorway.

He wants to go in. He could find one useful line. He could hold the packet and show that he still knows some of the work.

The sign says GROUP WORK. Public reading starts at four.

Ronan sits on the bench outside. He takes out his own book and opens it on his knees.

At four, Mei changes the sign. Leo clears the spare paper from the public tables. Miss Wu opens the door all the way.

Ronan comes in with two younger students. He chooses a place by the window.

Leo sees him and comes over.

“Why did you wait outside?” he asks.

Ronan looks toward Miss Wu. “Could I come in during group time?”

Leo follows his look. “You are right. I need to ask first. I am still learning the arrangements.”

“It is all right. The bench has a fine view of the wall.”

Leo smiles, but he does not offer Ronan a secret job. He goes back to the desk because a younger student has a question.

Ronan reads for twenty minutes. A girl near him cannot reach a book on the higher shelf. She asks him for it. He gives it to her, then returns to his own place.

He does not look toward the small desk for a mark.

When the public reading time ends, Leo puts on his bag. Mei stays to finish a label with Miss Wu. Ronan and Leo leave together.

“That was work,” Leo says.

“I saw you carry three packets.”

“And put one in the wrong pile. Mei caught it.”

For a moment, Ronan is glad Leo made a mistake. Then he wishes he did not feel glad. He asks if the packets are in the right place now.

“Yes.”

They walk past the food stall. This time, Ronan has his small coin ready.

“Still want food?” he asks.

Leo stops. “Yes.”

They buy one bun each. Ronan's is hot enough to hurt his fingers, so he holds it by the paper and waits.

Leo talks about the room. Ronan listens for a while, then tells him about his storybook. The two boys disagree about the story's last page. They explain their ideas, but they still disagree.

At the green door, Ronan has crumbs on his sleeve. He brushes them away before Mum sees, but she finds one on his chin and laughs.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

public＝向大家开放的；spare＝多余、备用的；pile＝一叠、一堆；crumb＝食物碎屑。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样处理自己和正式组员权限的区别？
2. Leo犯了一次小错时，Ronan有什么不完全体面的真实反应？

## 读句子

**Mei changes the sign.**

拆开看：Mei / changes / the sign.

Mei／更换／标牌。
